item.title: Resident raises safety concerns at Pine Harbor Apartments after fires and deadly stabbings
item.description: One tenant says a lack of security, ongoing maintenance problems, and unsanitary conditions have pushed her to move out after six years in the building.

item.title: Buffalo Sabres fan takes puck to the head, returns to her seat to watch 8th consecutive win
item.description: Katherine Bundt was struck by a stray puck during Tuesday's game but was determined to stay for the remainder of the game.

item.title: 'Would probably kill the project': Lockport considering moratorium on new multi-family developments
item.description: Developers of the Bewley Building in Lockport say plans could be in jeopardy if a vote currently under consideration to prohibit new approvals for multi-family developments passes.

item.title: Man convicted of double murders released on parole in Erie County; lawmakers outraged
item.description: A Wayne County man convicted of two murders he committed at age 14 is now in Erie County after being granted parole, and local lawmakers say they were blindsided by the decision.
